rationale: Saurabh brings hands-on experience shipping applied AI projects—from AI agents to LLM-adjacent tooling—while Rakesh conducts AI research at Meta, creating a natural bridge between research rigor and production implementation. Both work in machine learning and AI systems; Saurabh's full-stack background in Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript complements Rakesh's research focus, making them well-positioned to explore how cutting-edge ML research translates into developer-facing tools and infrastructure.
intro_message: Saurabh Khire, meet Rakesh Ranjan — Rakesh's AI research at Meta paired with your shipped AI agents and LLM tooling experience could spark ideas on bridging research and production ML systems.
